title: Which month will the Palestinian Football Association announce for the resumption of its football competitions after their October 2023 suspension?
background: Palestinian football competitions have been suspended since the war in Gaza began in October 2023.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: An official Palestinian Football Association announcement, or reliable news reporting quoting its leadership.
  • Resolution Conditions: Use the first public announcement between July 1 and August 31, 2026, that specifies a date for restarting the suspended football competitions. Resolve to the calendar month containing that announced restart date, regardless of whether competitions subsequently begin as scheduled. If no qualifying announcement occurs by the deadline, the question is void.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The full English name of the month, not the month in which the announcement is made.

title: Which UK party leader will announce plans in early July 2026 to resign as an MP and contest the resulting by-election?
background: A parliamentary resignation can trigger a by-election, which the departing MP may contest to seek a fresh mandate.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Public announcements corroborated by contemporaneous reporting from BBC News, The Guardian, or Al Jazeera.
  • Resolution Conditions: Resolve to the UK political party leader who publicly announces, between July 1 and July 9, 2026, plans to resign from the House of Commons and stand in the by-election caused by that resignation. The announcement is sufficient; the by-election need not have taken place.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The party leader's full name.

title: Which UK university will be identified in nationwide reporting by the end of July 2026 as having investigated the most students for pro-Palestine activism between October 2023 and November 2025?
background: Pro-Palestinian campus protests in Britain have prompted disputes over university disciplinary practices and freedom of expression.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Nationwide comparative reporting by Al Jazeera and Liberty Investigates, drawing on university Freedom of Information disclosures and available by July 31, 2026.
  • Resolution Rule: Resolve to the university with the highest reported number of students subjected to disciplinary investigations for pro-Palestine activism between October 2023 and November 2025 among the universities covered. Investigations need not have resulted in sanctions.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The name of the university.

title: Who will Moldova’s parliament elect as prime minister to succeed Alexandru Munteanu?
background: Alexandru Munteanu has resigned as Moldova’s prime minister, triggering his cabinet’s resignation. Moldova is pursuing European Union membership.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official Moldovan parliamentary announcements or reliable news reporting confirming the election of a new prime minister.
  • Resolution Condition: Resolve to the first person elected prime minister by Moldova’s parliament following Alexandru Munteanu’s resignation. A nomination or temporary appointment as acting prime minister does not qualify.
  • Resolution Date: The date parliament elects the successor.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The full name of the person elected.

title: Which company will hold the record for the largest US IPO by a foreign firm as of July 10, 2026?
background: Alibaba's 2014 US initial public offering raised $25 billion, setting the record for the largest US IPO by a foreign company.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official issuer announcements and contemporaneous reporting by reputable news organizations.
  • Resolution Conditions: Resolve to the company reported as holding the all-time record for the largest US initial public offering by a foreign company as of July 10, 2026. Compare offerings by proceeds raised, not company valuation. An offering whose pricing and share sales have been announced may qualify before exchange trading begins.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The company's commonly used name.

title: Which European country will declare a national emergency in response to wildfires between July 1 and July 25, 2026?
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official national government announcements or reliable news reporting published by July 25, 2026.
  • Resolution Condition: Identify the European country whose national government declares a national emergency because of wildfires between July 1 and July 25, 2026. Regional or local emergency declarations alone do not qualify.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The country's commonly used English name.

title: Which European country will announce plans to shut down its only nuclear power plant because of drought-related cooling-water shortages by August 2, 2026?
background: Nuclear power plants that use river water for cooling can face operational restrictions when drought reduces the available water supply.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official government statements or contemporaneous reporting by established news organizations.
  • Resolution Rule: Identify the European country whose government announces, between July 1 and August 2, 2026, inclusive, plans for a complete shutdown of its sole operating nuclear power plant because drought has reduced the river water available for reactor cooling. The announcement of the shutdown plan is sufficient; the shutdown itself need not have occurred. A partial reduction in electricity output alone does not qualify.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The country's commonly used English name.

title: Which Southeast Asian country will announce a finalized voluntary repatriation plan for thousands of Myanmar refugees in August 2026?
background: Repatriation means returning refugees to their country of origin. This question concerns finalization of a government plan, rather than the completion of refugee returns.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official government statements or reliable news reporting directly quoting those statements.
  • Resolving Event: During August 2026, a Southeast Asian government publicly confirms that it has finalized a voluntary repatriation programme, or the first phase of such a programme, covering at least 1,000 refugees from Myanmar. A preliminary agreement to consider returns is insufficient. Actual departures need not have occurred.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The common English name of the country finalizing the repatriation plan, not the destination country.

title: Which candidate will receive the most “encourage” votes in the first UN Security Council straw poll of the 2026 secretary-general selection?
background: António Guterres is serving as UN secretary-general. Informal Security Council straw polls gauge support for potential successors, with members indicating whether they encourage, discourage or have no opinion on each candidate.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official UN information or contemporaneous reporting by reputable international news organizations describing the first Security Council straw poll in the 2026 secretary-general selection process.
  • Resolution Condition: Resolve to the candidate receiving the highest number of “encourage” votes in that first poll, regardless of subsequent polls or the final appointment.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The candidate’s full name.

title: Who will be appointed to succeed Pape Thiaw as head coach of Senegal's men's national football team by August 31, 2026?
background: The Senegalese Football Federation is responsible for appointing the national team's head coach.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: An official announcement by the Senegalese Football Federation, as confirmed by contemporaneous reliable news reporting.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the person publicly announced as Pape Thiaw's successor between August 1 and August 31, 2026. The resolution date is the date the appointment is publicly announced, rather than the coach's presentation or first match.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The appointed coach's full name.

title: Which company will be the world's most valuable publicly traded company by market capitalization on July 17, 2026?
background: Market capitalization is the total market value of a company's outstanding shares.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Resolve to the company identified as the world's most valuable by market capitalization in Al Jazeera's contemporaneous reporting on July 17, 2026.
  • Resolution Date: 2026-07-17
  • Accepted Answer Format: Answer with the company's commonly used name.

title: Which country will the Spanish Football Federation announce as the host of the 2027 Spanish Super Cup?
background: The Spanish Super Cup features the winners and runners-up of La Liga and the Copa del Rey. Saudi Arabia has hosted the competition since 2020.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The Spanish Football Federation’s official host announcement, corroborated by reliable news reporting.
  • Resolution Conditions: Resolve to the country officially named as host of the 2027 Spanish Super Cup by August 31, 2026. This question concerns the announced host, not whether the tournament subsequently takes place there. Resolution occurs when the announcement is made.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The name of the host country, rather than the host city or stadium.

title: Which stadium will Shakhtar Donetsk announce an agreement to use for its home matches in the main phase of the 2026–27 UEFA Champions League?
background: War has prevented Shakhtar Donetsk from hosting European matches in Ukraine, forcing the club to arrange alternative venues abroad.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: An official Shakhtar Donetsk announcement, or reliable reporting quoting the club, identifying its agreed home venue for the 2026–27 Champions League main phase.
  • Resolution Conditions: Resolve to the stadium named in the first such agreement announced by August 31, 2026. The announcement determines the answer; subsequent regulatory approval or the actual staging of matches is not required.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The stadium’s name.

title: Which country's public broadcaster will announce a boycott of Eurovision 2027 in August 2026 over concerns about the contest's political neutrality?
background: Countries participate in the Eurovision Song Contest through national broadcasters, which decide whether to enter the competition.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: An official statement from the withdrawing broadcaster, corroborated by reliable contemporaneous news reporting.
  • Resolution Conditions: Resolve to the country whose public broadcaster announces during August 2026 that it will not participate in the 2027 Eurovision Song Contest, citing concerns about the contest's political neutrality.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The country's common English name.

title: Who will be the first major Ukrainian political figure to publicly call for wartime elections following Russia’s 2022 full-scale invasion?
background: Ukrainian law bars elections during wartime. The presidential election has been postponed under continuing martial law, although Volodymyr Zelenskyy’s presidential term ended in May 2024.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Public statements corroborated by reliable contemporaneous news reporting.
  • Qualifying Event: Identify the person credited in reliable reporting with the first public call by a major Ukrainian political figure since Russia’s 2022 full-scale invasion to resume national elections while the war continues. A call solely for elections after the war ends does not qualify.
  • Resolution Timing: Resolve when the qualifying statement becomes public, provided this occurs by August 31, 2026.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The politician’s full name.

title: Who will be Norway's reigning monarch on August 29, 2026?
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official Norwegian Royal House announcements, corroborated by contemporaneous reporting from major news organizations.
  • Resolution Rule: Identify the person legally holding Norway's crown at the beginning of August 29, 2026, local time. Accession determines the answer, regardless of whether an oath-taking ceremony or coronation has occurred.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The sovereign's regnal name, including the ordinal.

title: Who will be announced as the second-ranked candidate on Raam’s slate for Israel’s next parliamentary election by September 5, 2026?
background: Raam is an Arab political party in Israel led by Mansour Abbas. The party participated in Israel’s governing coalition formed in 2021.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: A public announcement by Mansour Abbas or Raam, as documented in official statements or contemporaneous news reporting.
  • Resolution Conditions: Resolve to the person publicly named by September 5, 2026, to occupy the second position on Raam’s electoral slate for the next Knesset election. An announcement of the planned candidacy is sufficient; formal registration or election to parliament is not required.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The person’s full name.

title: Who will Ghana appoint to lead the Black Stars for the September–October 2026 international window?
background: The Black Stars are Ghana's senior men's national football team.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The Ghana Football Association's official announcement appointing a head coach for the international window running from September 21 to October 6, 2026, corroborated by reliable news reporting.
  • Resolution Condition: Resolve to the first person appointed after August 1, 2026, and before the international window begins, to lead the team during that window. Both interim and permanent appointments qualify.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The appointed coach's full name.

title: Which party will receive the largest share of the vote in Berlin's 2026 state election?
background: Berlin is both a city and a German federal state. Its state election determines the composition of its parliament.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Results published by Berlin's election authority or reliable contemporaneous reporting of those results.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the party receiving the highest statewide vote share in Berlin's 2026 state election. Subsequent coalition negotiations and the selection of the mayor do not affect resolution.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The party's name or its standard abbreviation.

title: Who will be the first person charged in the United Kingdom over alleged involvement in the 1994 Rwandan genocide?
background: British authorities have been investigating allegations involving Rwandan genocide suspects living in the United Kingdom.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: An official public charging announcement from the United Kingdom’s Crown Prosecution Service.
  • Resolution: Identify the first individual formally charged in the United Kingdom in connection with alleged involvement in the 1994 Rwandan genocide, provided the charges are announced by December 31, 2026. Arrests without charges, extradition proceedings, and charges brought outside the United Kingdom do not qualify.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The person’s full name as given in the charging announcement.

title: Which former minister from Viktor Orban's government, if any, will have parliamentary immunity lifted in September 2026 to permit an embezzlement investigation?
background: The party that won Hungary's 2026 parliamentary election campaigned on tackling corruption. Parliamentary immunity can prevent prosecutors from pursuing criminal investigations against legislators unless Parliament lifts it.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Hungarian parliamentary records or contemporaneous reporting from reliable news organizations identifying former ministers whose immunity is lifted.
  • Qualifying Event: Hungary's Parliament must vote during September 2026 to remove a former Orban-government minister's immunity specifically to allow prosecutors to pursue an embezzlement investigation. Allegations alone, without the parliamentary vote, do not qualify.
  • Accepted Answer Format: Provide the former minister's full name. If no former minister qualifies during September 2026, resolve as no qualifying minister.

title: Which activist detained in Tunisia's Global Sumud Flotilla fundraising case will suspend his hunger strike between September 12 and September 27, 2026?
background: Four activists have been detained since March in a Tunisian investigation into alleged financial irregularities involving fundraising for the Global Sumud Flotilla, an international campaign seeking to deliver aid to Gaza. Hunger strikes are being used to protest their continued detention.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Contemporaneous reporting by Al Jazeera identifying which of the four detained activists has suspended his hunger strike.
  • Resolution Conditions: The suspension must have occurred between September 12 and September 27, 2026, inclusive. Appeals to suspend the strike or statements of future intention do not count.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The activist's full name.

title: Which city or region will the DOSB choose in 2026 to represent Germany in bidding for the 2036, 2040 or 2044 Summer Olympics?
background: The DOSB is Germany's national Olympic committee. Its domestic candidate selection is separate from the International Olympic Committee's eventual decision on which country will host the Games.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The DOSB's official selection announcement, as confirmed by reliable news reporting.
  • Resolution Conditions: Resolve to the city or region officially selected during 2026 to represent Germany in bidding for the 2036, 2040 or 2044 Summer Olympics. This concerns Germany's domestic candidate selection, not the eventual international host selection.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The name of the selected city or region.

title: Who will Morocco's king appoint as prime minister following the country's 2026 parliamentary election?
background: Morocco's prime minister leads the government and is appointed by the king.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The Moroccan royal palace's public announcement, as documented in reliable news reporting.
  • Resolution Condition: Resolve to the first person appointed prime minister and tasked with forming a government following Morocco's 2026 parliamentary election.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The appointee's name or commonly used surname.

title: Which court, if any, will grant Christa Pike a stay on the day of her scheduled September 30, 2026 execution?
background: Christa Pike is on Tennessee's death row for the 1995 killing of Colleen Slemmer.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Use the court's order or contemporaneous reporting to identify the court.
  • Resolution Date: Resolve to the court that grants a stay of Pike's execution on September 30, 2026, before her scheduled execution time that day.
  • Accepted Answer Format: Answer with its commonly used short name.

title: Who will win Okinawa's 2026 gubernatorial election?
background: Okinawa is Japan's southernmost prefecture, where the presence of US military bases is a major political issue.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official results announced by Okinawa's election authorities, either directly or as reported by reliable news organizations.
  • Resolution: The question resolves when the winner of Okinawa's 2026 gubernatorial election is officially announced.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The winning candidate's full name.
